title: eBGP session to non-adjacent peer stays Active — multihop not configured
symptom: R2 eBGP session toward loopback 10.10.10.2 (R4, two hops away) stays in Active state indefinitely. No BGP OPEN is received. Ping to 10.10.10.2 succeeds (ICMP) but BGP does not establish.

inject.note: Session is configured to a non-directly connected loopback (two IGP hops away). Without ebgp-multihop, BGP TCP SYNs are sent with TTL=1 and are dropped by the intervening router before reaching 10.10.10.2.

ground_truth.root_cause: eBGP neighbor 10.10.10.2 is not directly connected — ebgp-multihop not configured, TCP SYN dropped by TTL exhaustion after first hop
ground_truth.fix: router bgp 65001 / neighbor 10.10.10.2 ebgp-multihop 2 / neighbor 10.10.10.2 update-source Loopback0
ground_truth.verify: show ip bgp neighbors 10.10.10.2 shows Established after multihop + update-source configured
